name: Zeikun
source:
Blunt and straightforward. He prefers to be alone and often asks or chases others away. Even though he has a cool character, he cannot resist getting angry at persistent people. Despite his bad attitude, he secretly cares a lot for the ones he likes. Since he avoids questions, the heroine thinks he is hiding something.

[From [url=https://darknights-time.weebly.com/zeikun.html]official site[/url]]
